_README: THE RECORDED FACT. This file is what the DOCS are checked against, so the main gate
in test/registry-doc-truth.test.ts needs NO NETWORK and cannot be decided by a third
party's uptime. It is a dated measurement of one moving published fact.
The SEPARATE opt-in live lane (UI2API_REGISTRY_LIVE=1) compares THIS against the world and
reports drift as a NAMED VERDICT — it never fails the suite on drift, because a gate that
cries wolf about a publication claim is the failure shape this repo refuses to ship
If a number here is wrong it was wrong WHEN MEASURED — that is why measuredAt is required and
why the live lane names the drift instead of silently trusting either side. Do NOT hand-edit a
subject: the public ui2api registry that `ui2api install` defaults to
measuredBy: GOAL 209, measured on the dev box with this repo's own installer (src/registry/install.ts fetchRegistryIndex) for the entry count, and GET api.github.com/repos/MeRezaRezaei/ui2api-registry for the repo facts. Re-take with: UI2API_REGISTRY_LIVE=1 npm run test:unit -- test/registry-doc-truth.test.ts (the live lane prints the drift verdict) — then edit this file to the numbers it reports. A snapshot that was never measured is a lie; every number here was read off a real response.
